summary.text: John Eder is a Republican state representative who has represented Maine House District 136 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2003 to 2007, representing District 118.

paragraphs.text: Eder is listed by Ballotpedia as self-employed.
He previously represented Maine House District 118 from 2003 to 2007 and returned to the House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Heidi Sampson in District 136.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
